test_get_auth_url: test the get_auth_url function that generates an OAuth authorization URL with PKCE and saves pending auth state
test_exchange_auth_code: test the exchange_auth_code function that exchanges an OAuth code for a token using saved PKCE material
test_check_auth: test the check_auth function that validates stored credentials and auto-refreshes expired tokens
test_store_client_secret: test the store_client_secret function that copies and validates a Google OAuth client_secret.json file
test_revoke: test the revoke function that revokes a token with Google and deletes stored credential files
